name: studio-paths-terrain-save
description: (2): Studio's terrain editor moves every selected object (selectAll, Numpad6), saves (editors.saveAll) and packs; the editor opens that map (from: studio) and re-saves; (4) the regenerated war3map.lua of that save. skinIds ignored (a field of the doo version 8 the map has; the editor writes version 13 without it). Units: expected to differ in the height of the neutral buildings (tavern, marketplace, goblin merchant, shop, mercenary camps, ntrt/ntrg) the editor's save puts up to 5.2 off Studio's (the stored height, or after a move the ground at the point) (the editor's ground for buildings isn't known: not the point's ground, not a mean or maximum of points round it; bugs.md); units 5, 13, 14, 18, 27, 32, 54, 67, 73, 75, 77, 81, 87, 88, 89, 92, 97 (measured 2026-11-17); every other unit's height must match

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.selectAll'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const xs = () => (s.placedObjects()?.doodads ?? []).map((d) => d.position[0]); const before = xs(); const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: '6', code: 'Numpad6', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); const after = xs(); const moved = after.filter((x, i) => x > before[i]).length; if (!moved || after.length !== before.length) throw new Error(`Numpad6 moved ${moved} of ${before.length} doodads (now ${after.length})`); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: studio-paths-matrix-masks
description: (5) MatrixPCDefense_v4.3 (all-zero ally masks in its w3i; the editor refuses it without a war3map.wtg, so make-studio-paths.mjs adds echo's): the editor's save against Studio's pack. Differs for the editor's own reasons, not the masks: the map has no placed units, so the editor places start locations of its own (player 0 at -8960,-3968; the w3i says -3400,6300) and writes them and the masks worked out from them into the w3i at random: player 0 at -8960,-3968 in one run, -490,5669 in the next (2026-11-17), so the masks worked out from them are random too and are ignored (that they agree with allies.rs's rule for the editor's starts was seen by hand once); the editor counts that change as an edit (saves 1 to 2). Also ignored: scriptType, supportedModes, gameDataVersion and the enemy masks, which the editor's newer w3i version has and the map's version 25 hasn't. Checked: the starts, saves and the names are what differs; the editor writes the player and force names (inline in Studio) as TRIGSTR_ strings of the borrowed wts
